source_title: En Que Moneda Obtendre Mi Comision
snippet_primary: "Debido a la nueva normativa del Banco Central de la República Argentina (BCRA), que amplió el plazo para las remesas al exterior y afectó la liquidación de operaciones, se estandarizó la aplicación de una tarifa en los pagos con conversión de compra con pesos argentinos (ARS) para ofertas en dólares estadounidenses (USD), o conversiones de comisiones en dólares estadounidenses (USD) para productos ofertados en pesos argentinos (ARS)."
subject_exact: Hotmart commission currency help center (help.hotmart.com/es, as of April 2026) states that due to Argentine Central Bank (BCRA) regulations extending remittance timelines abroad, Hotmart standardized a fee on payments involving ARS-to-USD conversions (Argentine buyers purchasing USD-priced products) or USD-to-ARS conversions (USD commissions for ARS-priced products)
metric_value_raw: standardized conversion fee for ARS/USD conversions; exact rate not specified
local_qualifiers: Hotmart help (as of Apr 2026): BCRA regulations triggered standardized fee for ARS/USD conversions in Argentina; affects both ARS purchases of USD products and USD commissions for ARS products
parser_notes: help.hotmart.com (as of Apr 2026). Spanish. Argentina-specific BCRA conversion fee. BCRA extended remittance timelines, affecting ARS/USD operations. Fee amount not disclosed in snippet.
